description:
Lists the analysed meetings the caller may see, as cards, newest first, with the filter choices the Meetings screen offers. Use it to show or search the meeting list, and to find a meetingId for Get Meeting, Get Meeting Transcript, Get Share Link or the notes routes (meetings[].id).

Any member of the company may call it, but what comes back depends on their role. An owner or admin sees every meeting in the company. A member sees only the meetings they booked or were invited to, plus every meeting of each team they are in (only their own when they are in no team). It never returns meetings from a company other than the one named in x-company-id.

Paging: send limit (1 to 100) to get pages. When there are more results, nextCursor holds a token; pass it back as cursor to get the next page. nextCursor is null on the last page. Without limit, every matching meeting comes back in one response. Never build a cursor yourself.

The first page (no cursor) also carries the extras: filters (the types, tags, people and teams that actually occur, each with a count), totals (all meetings the caller may see, and how many of them still need attention, ignoring the filters) and processing (up to 50 meetings the caller may see that are still being analysed, newest first). On later pages filters and totals are null and processing is empty, so keep the first page's copy. meetingCount is the number of matches across all pages. In filters.people, team is true for someone who was ever on the company's side of a call.

Filters combine: q searches title, headline, summary, type, tag, a participant's name or email, a team's name, or an exact meeting id; type, tag and person take values from filters; teamId limits to meetings booked by or with that team's members (an id from filters.teams[].value); within keeps meetings from the last N days; from and to pick a custom date range instead; status is open (still needs something) or handled.

Team filter: an owner or admin may pass any of the company's teams. A member may pass only a team they are in, and filters.teams lists only their teams.

A company with no meetings gets an empty list, not an error.

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED when a query value is out of range, a date cannot be read, or the cursor is not one this server issued; 401 when not signed in or the sign-in expired; 404 TEAM_NOT_FOUND when teamId is not one of this company's teams, or (for a member) not a team they are in. GET https://meet-analyzer-api.50agents.com/api/v1/ui/meetings?q=&type=&person=&tag=&teamId=&within=&from=&to=&status=&cursor=&limit=

cursor.description: Optional. The nextCursor from the previous page. Omit for the first page

from.description: Optional. Start of a custom date range, a date or date-time (ISO 8601), inclusive. Either end may be left open

limit.description: Optional. Page size, 1 to 100. Omit to get every matching meeting at once

person.description: Optional. A participant's name, a value from filters.people[].value

q.description: Optional. Free-text search, up to 200 characters. Matches title, headline, summary, type, tag, a participant's name or email, a team's name, or an exact meeting id

status.description: Optional. open (still needs something) or handled

tag.description: Optional. A tag, a value from filters.tags[].value

teamId.description: Optional. A team id from filters.teams[].value. Keeps meetings that team's members booked or were invited to. A member may only pass a team they are in

to.description: Optional. End of a custom date range, a date or date-time (ISO 8601), exclusive

type.description: Optional. Meeting type, a value from filters.types[].value, e.g. SALES, SUPPORT, PARTNERSHIP, MARKETING, INTERNAL

within.description: Optional. Whole number 1 to 3650: only meetings that started within this many days

name: list_meetings
